0022600001.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons, with the Celtics visiting the Pistons, and Boston will be without Sam Hauser, who is day-to-day and averaged 9.2 points in 24.8 minutes per game last season. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, but Boston lost the 2025-26 series 1-3, and their most recent meeting was a 104-103 loss in Detroit on January 19, 2026. ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Celtics a 50% chance to win.
